project: Z Best Media & Z Best Clips
rules: No contact-sheet crops or upscaled thumbnails may be promoted as final
No faces or unauthorized real logos
Exact text must be independently verified
Explicit aspect ratio and intrinsic dimensions
Do not commit to production without visual QA and review
